ctx.x: Well, they had old people in there, that's right. Only place I ever heard of Big Al Lewis. I knew it. How did he die? That's where I knew it. How long did he die? He died in 49. 49. Yeah, he made those records and played for about two weeks before he died. Yeah, I think. You know? No, I think not. What about the Sweet Potato Inn? You never did tell me much about that.

Well, there was a homebrew joint. Al, Durier, he played there. If you should happen to meet Al, he could sort of breathe on that. It was similar to the Naubeville Street or Abedville Street. And they had the Whip there too, somewhere else in one. That's where Lillard Primmer played for a while. And Lillard Primmer also played at the Frolic, which was on San Yen and Braw there. Lillard Buzzover played there. I played a few spots before the Lillard, but I don't know.
And the Vanity, did you ever go to the Vanity?
